summary: 管理收入确认与结算/合同条款只读配对核对首片 on BASE c640a1c. Added pmo_plugins/management_revenue/pairing_read_services.py with two read-only interfaces. revenue_pairing_snapshot(member, *, project_id=None, period=None, as_of=None) derives, per project or as an aggregate with per-project rows: contract_value (approved contract line net via contracts.approved_contract_totals), recognized (posted RevenueRecognition net minus posted RevenueAdjustment via the management-revenue owner export, with a read-only line-level fallback when the owner export needs a missing accounting event), settled (active Settlement gross via settlement_snapshot), unsettled (active OpenItem gross minus active Clearance), cash_coverage (active Clearance total), difference (recognized-settled), contract_variance (contract_value-recognized), terminated flag/terminated contract refs, and capped recognition/settlement refs. revenue_pairing_issues(member, *, as_of=None) returns issue_code/refs/expected/actual for recognized_over_contract_line, recognition_source_invalid, recognized_after_termination, settlement_source_invalid, settlement_after_termination, settlement_without_recognition, settled_exceeds_recognized, terms_without_recognition, cross_project_reference, cross_org_reference and duplicate_recognition. Permissions are owner/finance/auditor full, PM only managed projects, member denied; the new history_read route revenue-pairing renders a read-only page (project/period/as_of filters, unknown params rejected 400) and stays readable when management_revenue is disabled, with no POST/write entry. No model, migration, canonical schema, write path or business fact is changed; the service writes no audit, receipt, event or fact. Gold: contract net 100000, recognized 60000, active settlement 40000, open item 40000 with 30000 active clearance => snapshot recognized/settled/unsettled(10000)/cash(30000)/difference(20000)/variance(40000) and issues=[]; anomaly fixtures (all INSERT-only/legal service transitions, no UPDATE/DELETE of history) hit over-cap recognition, settlement without recognition, recognition/settlement after termination, cross-project and settled-exceeds-recognized issues.

review.reviewer: independent PH-284 revenue-pairing reviewer (fresh context, read-only)
findings: BLOCKER - denied settlement snapshots are silently converted to zero instead of missing: `_settlements` catches PermissionDenied/ValidationError from `receivable_services.settlement_snapshot` and simply `continue`s, so a pm (or any caller) whose settlement read is rejected receives settled_cents=0, unsettled_cents=0 and cash_coverage_cents=0 with no `missing` marker, i.e. fabricated clean data. The spec/Lead explicitly requires 'pm 仅管理项目（settlement 快照被拒时显示缺失不伪造)'. Fix: record denied/errored settlement refs in a `missing`/`settlement_missing` field and return null (not 0) for the affected settled/unsettled/cash aggregates (or surface a readable=false section), and add a regression where a settlement snapshot is denied and the result is missing/null rather than zero.

PASSED CHECKS: read-only purity (snapshot/issues only SELECT; fact counts/audit/events unchanged; no migration/write); contract_value=approved terms net (100000), recognized=posted net+adjustments (60000), settled=active Settlement gross (40000), unsettled=active OpenItem gross-active Clearance (10000), cash_coverage=active cleared (30000), difference=recognized-settled (20000), contract_variance=contract_value-recognized (40000) all match the gold fixture; 11 issue codes (over-contract/line, source invalid, terminated recognition/settlement, settlement without/over recognition, duplicate, cross-project/org, terminated terms) are exercised by the service tests; period/as_of filters; owner/finance/auditor full, pm managed project (recognized path), member denied; management_revenue-disabled history read; read-only UI/no POST; 14 changed files all inside PH-284 allowed_paths; task in_review, manifest=PH-284.
